title: Finite surjective descent of global sections for etale sheaves of sets
statement: Let $f:X'\to X$ be a morphism of schemes which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], let $X''=X'\times_XX'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $p_1,p_2:X''\to X'$, and $f_1=f\circ p_1=f\circ p_2$. Let $G$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and use the inverse images, the pullbacks $e^*$ of sections and the isomorphisms $c$ of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] (identifying $X\times_XX'$ with $X'$ and $X'\times_{X',p_j}X''$ with $X''$ by the canonical isomorphisms of [def-pc-fibre-product], so that $f^*s\in\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)$ for $s\in\Gamma(X,G)$ and $c_{f,p_j,G}(p_j^*s')\in\Gamma(X'',f_1^{-1}G)$ for $s'\in\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)$). Then the map $\Gamma(X,G)\to\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)$, $s\mapsto f^*s$, is injective, and its image is the set of $s'\in\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)$ with $c_{f,p_1,G}(p_1^*s')=c_{f,p_2,G}(p_2^*s')$ in $\Gamma(X'',f_1^{-1}G)$. That is, $\Gamma(X,G)$ is the equalizer of $\Gamma(X',f^{-1}G)\rightrightarrows\Gamma(X'',f_1^{-1}G)$.

source.place: Remark Tag 09Z3 (remark-cohomological-descent-finite), for sheaves of sets, proved 'in exactly the same way' as Lemma Tag 09Z2 (lemma-cohomological-descent-finite), by showing that G is the equalizer of f_{0,*}f_0^{-1}G => f_{1,*}f_1^{-1}G on stalks

proof.text: Use the proved finite-surjective unit injectivity lemma for the first conjunct. Its proof uses geometric-point lifting and the inverse-image germ formula, followed by geometric-germ extensionality.
For the forward implication of the equalizer equivalence, apply the compatible-section lifting lemma.

For the reverse implication substitute the given unit preimage. The chosen comparison unit equation, followed by cancellation of the inverse fibre-product pasting map, identifies each projection comparison with the unit for its composite. Transport of this unit section along pullback.condition (proved by substitution of equal arrows) gives their equality.

split_report.summary: Proof written in ten steps after Stacks Remark 09Z3 and the proof of Lemma 09Z2 transposed to sheaves of sets: f_1 finite (permanence + composition); the sheaves A=f_*f^{-1}G, B=f_{1*}f_1^{-1}G, the unit eta and the maps delta_j built from p_j^* and c_{f,p_j,G}; eta equalizes them (clause (1) of the composition node) and factors through the sectionwise equalizer E; on stalks at a geometric point xbar, with P the lifts of xbar (nonempty by surjectivity and lem-weil-pbc-finite-geometric-point-lift) and P_1 = P x P, the finite pushforward stalk (sets) and the new germ-compatible inverse-image stalk bijection identify eta with the diagonal and delta_j with the map induced by the j-th projection (the compatibility of c_{f,p_j,G} with the stalk bijections is proved in step 7 by checking on germs of f^*a, no filteredness used); so psi:G->E is bijective on stalks, hence an isomorphism, and global sections give the statement. Statement: only a parenthetical added naming the canonical identifications X x_X X' = X' and X' x_{X'} X'' = X'' the statement already used implicitly. New node: lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-stalk-germ (Stacks 03Q1 (3) for sets, with germs; unsplit). Lean: none on slopmaster2 for 09Z2/09Z3.

lean.statement: theorem finiteSurjectiveSetDescent {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [Surjective f] (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) : Function.Injective (etaleSetDescentUnit f G (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))) ∧ ∀ s' : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G).obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))), etaleSetDescentComparison f (pullback.fst f f) G (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s' = eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : pullback f f ⟶ X ↦ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj G).obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)).symm) (etaleSetDescentComparison f (pullback.snd f f) G (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s') ↔ ∃ s : G.obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))), etaleSetDescentUnit f G (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s = s'
